'''Hal Stern'''  is an American statistician, with a focus on [[Bayesian statistics]] and is one of the authors of the textbook ''Bayesian Data Analysis''.<ref>{{cite book | last1=Gelman | first1=A. | last2=Carlin | first2=J.B. | last3=Stern | first3=H.S. | last4=Dunson | first4=D.B. | last5=Vehtari | first5=A. | last6=Rubin | first6=D.B. | date=2013 | title=Bayesian Data Analysis | publisher=Chapman and Hall/CRC | doi=10.1201/b16018 | ISBN=978-0-429-11307-9 }}</ref>

Stern has developed several statistical methods in [[forensic science]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=National institute awards $20 million in renewed funding to forensic science center |url=https://news.uci.edu/2020/05/18/national-institute-awards-20-million-in-renewed-funding-to-forensic-science-center/ |access-date=June 7, 2024 |website=UCI News |language=en-US}}</ref> He also participates in the Forensic Science Advisory Committee of the [[American Statistical Association]].<ref>{{cite web |title=ASA Issues Guidance on Statistical Statements for Forensic Evidence|url=https://www.amstat.org/news-listing/2021/10/08/asa-issues-guidance-on-statistical-statements-for-forensic-evidence}}</ref>  He is a part of the leadership team of the Center for Statistics and Applications in Forensic Evidence (CSAFE).<ref>{{Cite web |title=Stern Co-Directs Award-Winning CSAFE Team |url=https://www.stat.uci.edu/stern-co-directs-award-winning-csafe-team/ |access-date=June 7, 2024 |website=www.stat.uci.edu}}</ref><ref name=":0" />

He is the Provost and Executive Vice Chancellor at the [[University of California, Irvine]] (UCI) and Chancellor's Professor in the Department of Statistics.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Hal S. Stern is named UCI provost and executive vice chancellor |url=https://news.uci.edu/2021/04/16/hal-s-stern-is-named-uci-provost-and-executive-vice-chancellor/ |access-date=June 7, 2024 |website=UCI News |language=en-US}}</ref>

Stern is a [[List of fellows of the American Statistical Association|fellow of the American Statistical Association]],<ref>{{cite web |title=Complete list of fellows of American Statistical Association |url=https://ww2.amstat.org/fellows/}}</ref> [[Fellow of the American Association for the Advancement of Science|American Association for the Advancement of Science]], [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]], and [[International Society for Bayesian Analysis]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Honored IMS Fellows |url= https://imstat.org/honored-ims-fellows/}}</ref> In 2022, Stern received the [[American Statistical Association Founders Award]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Founders Award|publisher=American Statistical Association|url=https://www.amstat.org/your-career/awards/founders-award}}</ref>
